scope: UI references and attributable profile image collection only. UI, canonical account data and AI-origin status are not modified.

reference_sources.method: crwl crawl -o markdown-fit; discovered via DuckDuckGo HTML

observed_ui.portrait: Avatar is a separately browsable UI element in the profile listing.
observed_ui.grid: The public browser screenshot visibly presents a two-column screenshot gallery beneath a large heading and compact category pills.
observed_ui.search: Search Results Page, Filtered Search Results and No Results examples are listed.
observed_ui.filter: Filtering & Sorting is a linked flow category.
observed_ui.density: Repeated concise screen labels with app names and category links; precise pixel spacing is not observed.
observed_ui.detail: Each screen label links to a /explore/screens/<id> detail.

copy_mechanism: Keep the search field and platform/AI-status filters directly above a compact result list.
Give the account name and icon a consistent location; group secondary metadata and detail links.
limits: Direct scrapy on browse/web/apps and the search URL returned 403 while crwl read the public explore listing.
No paid plan, login, signup or MCP connection is established.
No conversion or usability outcome is measured.
Search listing screenshot and Semrush detail screenshot are visually observed in the registered browser. Other profile-detail pixels remain unverified.

observed_ui.portrait: Seller Profile Page and User Profile Page carry Avatar, Card and Tile labels.
observed_ui.grid: Grid List appears on collection and user-image examples.
observed_ui.search: Profile examples are grouped under one explicit category.
observed_ui.filter: Filtering & Sorting appears on a customer-view example.
observed_ui.density: Examples include Side Navigation and Multi-Column Layout labels; exact dimensions are not verified.
observed_ui.detail: Creator Profile, Designer Profile View and Full Contact Profile link to individual screens.

copy_mechanism: Separate account identity, audience metadata and source evidence.
Use explicit profile/details links with a visible avatar for every row.
limits: Listing metadata is observed; visual composition and interactions are not verified.

reference_sources.method: crwl crawl homepage -o markdown-fit plus scrapy HTML

observed_ui.portrait: Named portrait images use profile-img-tall; some other images use avatar circle.
observed_ui.grid: Repeated profile image/name/handle links in collection-list searchable-list.
observed_ui.search: HTML input placeholder Search Virtual Human; search form placeholder Type anything....
observed_ui.filter: Musicians, Branded and First labels and filter-item elements.
observed_ui.density: Many profiles can be scanned using the same concise name and @handle pattern.

copy_mechanism: Make the face/name/handle the repeated identity block.
Provide direct search and compact filters before longer research evidence.
limits: The legacy /virtual-influencers URL returned a 404 page; the directory is on the homepage.
Actual search/filter interaction and visual layout dimensions are not exercised.
Audience, revenue or performance claims are not independently validated.

observed_ui.portrait: Category hub uses category labels; it does not establish persona portraits.
observed_ui.grid: Named category groups link to scoped lists.
observed_ui.search: No search interaction is verified in this extraction.
observed_ui.filter: Category names include counts and Show all links.
observed_ui.density: Grouped categories expose useful labels before long descriptions.
observed_ui.detail: Each category leads to a focused directory.

copy_mechanism: Expose platform and status as clear labels with visible result counts.
Keep explanatory copy short and move account evidence to detail sections.
limits: The homepage currently emphasizes personalized onboarding. The /ai-tools path holds the directory.
Counts are publisher-displayed snapshots, not independent measurements.

observed_ui.portrait: Extraction does not verify image appearance.
observed_ui.grid: Repeated ranked tool entries are present.
observed_ui.search: A category-scoped result list is visible in extracted content.
observed_ui.density: Rank, name, pricing class, short description, saves and View tool are consistently repeated.

copy_mechanism: Use one concise factual summary per item and a stable metadata order.
Label verification status directly and link out to its source.
limits: The page says ranking uses editor reviews, ratings and saves; their quality or outcomes are not independently measured.
No exact visual density or interaction behavior is confirmed.

reference_sources.method: crwl crawl -o markdown-fit plus scrapy profile HTML

observed_ui.portrait: The directory states it displays public profile images; the Ming San detail image alt says Ming San profile portrait. Yang Mun detail portrait is explicitly illustrative and is excluded from assets.
observed_ui.grid: HTML uses ih-grid with repeated mkt-card is-link ih-card anchor cards; the Ming San card contains its named portrait.
observed_ui.search: No search or input field is present in the fetched directory HTML; only a dismiss button is found.
observed_ui.filter: Niches are presented as metadata; active niche filtering is not verified.
observed_ui.density: Name, @handle, niche, followers, a short description and View profile repeat per account.
observed_ui.detail: /ai-influencers/<slug> pages include profile portrait and account-specific information.

copy_mechanism: Use identity-first cards with a clear audience number, platform and details action.
Avoid its unverified revenue promises and automatic AI classification.
limits: The vendor advertises directory size and revenue/production claims; these are not independently measured success evidence.
Illustrative portraits are excluded. Exact-handle third-party attributions remain explicitly classified and are not described as first-party images.

observed_ui: Logo, account/business name and main metadata align in repeated cards.
Result count and sort control sit above the list.
White rounded cards sit on a light-gray page background.

research_limits: No independently measured conversion/usability results are obtained for these reference directories. Use these as observed UI patterns, not proof of business success.
Mobbin public category listings are available even though tool/plugin discovery returned no installed Mobbin connector.
No new billing, topup, signup, auth change, message or publication is performed.

DuckDuckGo HTML began returning a human-verification challenge after the first exact-handle searches. Empty later results are not treated as evidence of no external account/profile. Search was not continued through that challenge.

superseded_profile_image_metadata.image_locator: directory card with exact @masteryunshen and img alt Master Yun Shen profile portrait
superseded_profile_image_metadata.limits: AvatarFactory attributes this portrait to the exact Instagram handle. The original Instagram image, ownership, AI origin and reuse license are not independently verified.

retrieval_diagnosis: Ordinary urllib image request returned HTTP403.
Registered-browser Flourish navigation returned HTTP200 and content-type image/webp.
Image bytes were saved with their actual MIME extension; no conversion or editing was performed.

cached_profile_image_search.scope: Repository English research JSON plus 29 task-related JSON files in the allowed local evidence folder.
cached_profile_image_search.result: Only the repository research JSON contains these targets. No stored profile_pic/profilePic/avatarThumb/avatarLarger/thumbnail fields are found.

final_public_source_probes.result: Both routes showed a security/CAPTCHA challenge; no account image or exact live handle was obtained.

final_public_source_probes.method: Registered TikTok browser identity with read capability; browser-guard acquired; owned new tab only; public profile JSON inspected; metadata-provided avatarMedium fetched; lease released.
final_public_source_probes.result: Exact uniqueId and platform user ID matched. Avatar request returned HTTP200 image/jpeg.

final_public_source_probes.method: Cached task research/evidence JSON search. Direct Instagram collection is not repeated.
final_public_source_probes.result: No stored avatar URL is found in the allowed task evidence scope.

connected_mobbin_recheck.method: Mobbin connected search_screens; platform web; 3 inline preview images visually inspected
connected_mobbin_recheck.availability_change: The connected tool is now available; earlier public-page retrieval remains an accurate record of that earlier check.

references.observed: Contacts list aligns small round avatars or colored initials with names. Creator/company filters and a search field sit above the list; an expanded contact occupies a separate right pane.
references.adopted_mechanism: Stable icon/name position, compact secondary metadata, list controls above results.

references.observed: Members heading, count and leadership segment appear above repeated white member rows. Every visible member row begins with a portrait and bold name, followed by lighter role/date details. Sort controls and member search appear above the rows.
references.adopted_mechanism: Name and portrait first; count, search and sort precede results.

references.observed: Team members view uses search/job controls, a name/job table and square initials or an account glyph where a portrait is absent. The selected person has a separate detail panel.
references.adopted_mechanism: Maintain an identifiable icon even when the source image is unavailable; disclose the fallback.

limits: No usability, conversion, revenue or growth effect is established by these images.
The examples inform layout only; no competitor screenshot or identity asset is shipped in the product.
Signed/expiring preview image URLs are not persisted.
